features.name: Bundle and launch LOLHEXGuide from League Akari
features.description: Package LOLHEXGuide as the user-facing Haidou Tools resource, add a Windows-only launch shard, expose a sidebar quick action beside Automation, and persist launch-on-start through League Akari settings.
doneCriteria: League Akari packages a reproducible LOLHEXGuide resource with version and integrity metadata.
A Windows-only main shard installs and launches LOLHEXGuide through GameBoxServer.exe with the required launch-chain environment.
The League Akari renderer exposes a localized Haidou Tools quick action beside Automation with loading, success, unsupported, and failure states.
The App settings page persists a launch-with-League-Akari option through the existing typed SQLite settings system.
Type checks, tests, visual QA, and a Windows package smoke check pass with evidence recorded.
features.evidence: 2026-08-31: original bundle, sidebar, settings, persistence, development, package, and push checks passed. Follow-up fix confirmed GameBoxServer.exe declares requireAdministrator; non-elevated League Akari now launches through the existing elevation helper with the required environment, while elevated processes keep the direct spawn path and EACCES also triggers an elevation fallback. The elevation helper smoke test returned 0 and launched the full process tree; Node/Web type checks, 100 test files and 567 tests, yarn build:win, and a packaged-app launch smoke test passed. Final package size: 239,114,414 bytes.
